context: Charm Log lines shown in a TUI pane with colors, and in a plain file

checklist.name: pane_profile_forced
checklist.description: Sets the pane logger's color profile explicitly (for example `SetColorProfile(colorprofile.TrueColor)`), because a logger built on a buffer, pipe, or custom writer detects no terminal and emits plain text; the Bubble Tea renderer downsamples the colors when the pane is drawn.

checklist.name: file_plain
checklist.description: Writes `app.log` through a logger built on the file (or with a plain profile), so the file has no escape codes; does not reuse the colored pane logger's output for the file.

checklist.name: goroutine_safe_delivery
checklist.description: Delivers lines from the worker goroutines to the model through messages (`p.Send`, a channel read by a command, or a writer that sends messages) or a mutex guarded buffer; `View` does not read a buffer that goroutines write without synchronization.

checklist.name: no_terminal_output
checklist.description: No logger writes to stdout or stderr while the program runs, and the package level logger is not left pointing at stderr if it is used.

checklist.name: last_twenty
checklist.description: Keeps only the last twenty lines for the pane and sizes the pane from `tea.WindowSizeMsg`.
